generalTips: Choose routes for your course, qualification, eligibility and budget; there is no universal number of exams to apply for.
Check the cycle and field-level source before using a deadline. Historical or needs-review records do not establish an open application window.
Read the official bulletin, later amendments and separate institution/counselling requirements before paying.
Use the syllabus and sample papers for the particular exam; engineering, medicine, law, management and design have different preparation requirements.
Budget separately for attempts, programme applications, counselling, travel and accommodation; fees may exclude taxes/charges.
Prepare the identity, education, category and accommodation documents required by the official instructions.
